scope: Native C++20 offline procedural audio workstation, bounded WAV processing and versioned preset/manifest exchange.

reference.warning: The supplied 66-point list mixes cumulative updates, inherited behavior, absence statements, repeated topics and Windows-specific constraints. It is not treated as an authoritative XP SP3 changelog or as a requirement to reproduce legacy Windows behavior.

adoption_rules.rule: Only claim implemented when repository code and tests or operational evidence support the exact behavior. Partial requires evidence and explicit limits. Not applicable requires a product-scope reason. Historical Windows features are not silently represented as native capabilities.

source_groups.title: User interface, shell, multimedia and storage

controls.assessment: Imported media and parameters are bounded and validated, rendering is offline, and export avoids overwriting existing files; no privileged host control is exposed.
limitations: Retain explicit size, frame-count, format and output-path guards.

controls.assessment: VentuSample is an offline workstation without a hosted backend, network playback path or remote control plane.
limitations: Do not add network access to the audio render path without a separately reviewed product requirement.

controls.assessment: CMake provides portable core and optional Qt desktop builds; there is no OS-level installer, updater or privileged servicing mechanism.
limitations: Keep release packaging separate from host audio/device configuration.

controls.assessment: A Qt desktop application, local presets, A/B slots and versioned WAV/JSON outputs exist; the application is not a general shell or audio-device host.
limitations: Preserve deterministic offline operation and explicit local-file boundaries.

controls.assessment: Preset schemas and manifest v1/v2 compatibility are documented, with bounded PCM16 WAV support; runtime audio-device and DAW compatibility are not claimed.
limitations: Version every interchange format and keep backward-compatibility tests.
